item.description:
What's new in 1.4.1

  • Screenshots and recordings work over full-screen apps again. With the Cueshot window open, the area you drag could fail over Safari or another app in full screen and say “The selection can't take input”; now it sits on top as it should.
  • See every plan right in the app. “All plans” in setup and “See all plans” in Settings open the checkout in Cueshot, where you compare Pro and Pro+, pick one and pay — no website, no dead link.
  • Your agent sees a single screenshot sharper. One screenshot, or one frame of a recording, now goes out at 2000 pixels instead of 1568, so small text stays readable; recordings with several frames cost the same as before.
